lemma fundamental_theorem_of_variational_calculus' {f : Y → V}
    (μ : Measure Y) [IsFiniteMeasureOnCompacts μ] [μ.IsOpenPosMeasure]
    [OpensMeasurableSpace Y]
    (hf : Continuous f) (hg : ∀ g, IsTestFunction g → ∫ x, ⟪f x, g x⟫_ℝ ∂μ = 0) :
    f = 0 := by
  funext x
  by_contra hx
  change f x ≠ 0 at hx
  have hp : 0 < ⟪f x, f x⟫_ℝ :=
    (show 0 ≤ ⟪f x, f x⟫_ℝ from real_inner_self_nonneg').lt_of_ne'
      (fun h => hx (inner_self_eq_zero'.mp h))
  have hc := Continuous.inner' (𝕜 := ℝ) f (fun _ => f x) hf continuous_const
  obtain ⟨r, hr, hpos⟩ := Metric.eventually_nhds_iff.mp
    (continuousAt_const.eventually_lt hc.continuousAt hp)
  haveI : HasContDiffBump Y := hasContDiffBump_of_innerProductSpace Y
  let φ : ContDiffBump x := ⟨r / 2, r, half_pos hr, half_lt_self hr⟩
  have hφ : IsTestFunction (φ : Y → ℝ) := ⟨φ.contDiff, φ.hasCompactSupport⟩
  have hz := hg (fun y => φ y • f x) (hφ.smul_right contDiff_const)
  simp only [inner_smul_right'] at hz
  have hn : 0 ≤ (fun y => φ y * ⟪f y, f x⟫_ℝ) := by
    intro y
    by_cases hy : y ∈ Function.support φ
    · exact mul_nonneg φ.nonneg (hpos (by simpa only [φ.support_eq, Metric.mem_ball, φ] using hy)).le
    · simp [Function.notMem_support.mp hy]
  have hi := (hφ.smooth.continuous.mul hc).integral_pos_of_hasCompactSupport_nonneg_nonzero (μ := μ)
    (φ.hasCompactSupport.mul_right) hn
    (mul_ne_zero (ne_of_gt (φ.pos_of_mem_ball (Metric.mem_ball_self hr))) (ne_of_gt hp))
  exact (ne_of_gt hi) hz
